ValidationRule.description: US-03 refinement 3 and US-06 AC1: credited donations need first and last name or a company; invoices need the company (legal entity) or first and last name (individual).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Donation', OR(NOT(Is_Anonymous__c), Invoice_Requested__c), IF(AND(Invoice_Requested__c, ISPICKVAL(Person_Type__c, 'Company')), ISBLANK(Donor_Company__c), IF(AND(Invoice_Requested__c, ISPICKVAL(Person_Type__c, 'Individual')), OR(ISBLANK(Donor_First_Name__c), ISBLANK(Donor_Last_Name__c)), AND(ISBLANK(Donor_Company__c), OR(ISBLANK(Donor_First_Name__c), ISBLANK(Donor_Last_Name__c))))))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Captura tu nombre y apellidos o, si eres persona moral, el nombre de tu empresa.
